learning_objective: 🎯 Travel back in time and learn how to safely collect, organize, and proudly display fascinating historical objects like a real museum curator!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A museum is a special place where important, beautiful, or very old things are kept safe. It is like a time machine that helps us learn how people lived long ago.
You do not need gold to make a museum! Old coins, stamps, traditional toys, or even an old camera from your grandparents can be an amazing artifact to showcase.
A curator decides how to display the items. They carefully clean the objects and write small information cards (labels) so visitors know exactly what the item is and its history.

fun_activity.title: 🏺 My Mini Home Museum
fun_activity.instructions: Find one interesting old item in your house, like a special coin or a family photo. Write a small label on a piece of paper with its name, year, and a fun fact, then display it on a shelf!

quick_recap: ⭐ Museums help us preserve and learn from the amazing stories of the past.
⭐ Everyday old items can be precious artifacts if they tell a unique story.
⭐ Labeling and displaying items neatly helps visitors learn and enjoy the exhibition.
